market_summary: Bredere marked var svagt i dag, men AI-infrastruktur-narrativet fortsætter med at løfte MRVL (2nm-chip-gennembrud, hyperscaler-aftale), KEYS (test-og-måling til AI data centers) og CRWD (Snowflake-partnerskab). Dagens analyseunivers dækkede kun de 9 eksisterende holdings — ingen nye scout-/bull-kandidater at vurdere, så ingen nye køb i dag. To positioner lukkes: INVH sælges da det mekaniske stop-loss ($26,66) er brudt (kurs $26,50), og CRWD tages i gevinst (+13,9%) da kursen har ramt price target ($260) samtidig med ekstremt overkøbte tekniske niveauer (RSI 78,5, stoch 93) og en nedgraderet NEUTRAL-vurdering.

decisions.name: Marvell Technology
decisions.reasoning: Tesen forbliver stærkt intakt: et konkret 2nm AI data-center chip-gennembrud og fortsat hyperscaler-momentum bekræfter AI-silicon-væksthistorien. RSI 73/stoch 87 er overkøbt og narrativet er blevet crowded, men aktien er stadig 21,5% under 52-ugers high og langt fra target ($275) og stop ($162,53) — holdes uændret.
bull: 18% above the 50-day SMA and 60% above the 200-day, with a genuine new catalyst (reported 2nm AI data-center chip breakthrough) reinforcing the custom-silicon growth story
Still 21.5% below its 52-week high, so there is room to re-rate even after the recent 20-day run
bear: RSI 73 and stoch 87 are overbought, and the wall of 'MRVL vs NVDA/QCOM' comparison pieces signals the AI-chip trade here is now crowded and sentiment-driven
Custom-silicon revenue is lumpy and hyperscaler-concentrated — any single customer's capex pause would hit disproportionately

investment_plan.thesis: Sector-wide chip sympathy-selloff created a deeply oversold entry into a long-term intact AI-silicon growth case, since confirmed by a concrete Google design win and fresh acquisition news, and now a landmark hyperscaler AI deal.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $162.53 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis Kina-hukommelseskonkurrencen viser sig strukturel, eller ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
decisions.reasoning: Dyb RSI-oversolgt tilbagetrækning (RSI 28,8) inden for en intakt opadgående trend; positive fase II-data på inaxaplin styrker kidney disease-pipelinen som ny vækstmotor ud over CF-franchisen. Holder fortsat over både 50- og 200-dages SMA — holdes uændret.
bull: Still above both the 50-day (+1.9%) and 200-day (+10.9%) SMAs despite a 20-day pullback (-5.5%) and an RSI of 29 — this looks like a dip within an intact uptrend rather than a reversal, and one outlet flags the stock as up to 24% undervalued
Pipeline optionality beyond its core CF franchise (kidney disease programs povetacicept/inaxaplin) offers a call option on new growth engines
bear: RSI 28.8 / stoch 36 reflect real near-term weakness, and 20-day momentum is negative even though the stock rose today against a soft broader market
Pipeline read-throughs are early-stage — kidney disease trial data could disappoint and remove the 'undervalued on pipeline' bull case

investment_plan.thesis: Deeply oversold entry in a technically intact uptrend, with the Crinetics acquisition signaling offensive pipeline expansion — since confirmed by raised guidance, a completed buyback, and now a Goldman Sachs Conviction List addition.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $448.95 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis Crinetics-opkøbet viser overbetaling/integrationsproblemer, eller ved pipeline-skuffelse.

decisions.name: Flex Ltd.
decisions.reasoning: Axiom AI-infrastruktur spin-off-narrativet og en rapporteret AI power-aftale giver fortsat en distinkt katalysator versus resten af EMS-gruppen. Stadig under 50-dages SMA, så den tekniske vending er ikke bekræftet endnu, men trenden er intakt over 200-dages SMA (+14,7%) — holdes uændret.
bull: Well above the 200-day SMA (+14.7%) with RSI 59 and rising 5-day momentum (+4.2%), and the Axiom AI-infrastructure spin-off plus a reported AI power deal give it a distinct data-center catalyst versus the rest of the contract-manufacturing group
Still 33% below its 52-week high despite the recent strength, leaving room to re-rate if the Axiom narrative gains traction
bear: Currently below its own 50-day SMA (-2.8%), so the bounce hasn't yet reclaimed the intermediate trend
Spin-offs take time to prove out — if Axiom fails to deliver a clear valuation uplift, the stock could revert to trading as a low-margin EMS name

investment_plan.thesis: Beat-and-raise earnings ignored by the market in a broad tech selloff gave a deeply oversold entry; the EPC Power acquisition adds a fresh AI-infrastructure catalyst but also integration risk.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $85,68 (2x ATR). Sælg ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse eller fortsat makrodrevet selloff uden bundtegn, eller ved tegn på fejlslagen EPC Power-integration.

decisions.name: Walt Disney Company (The)
decisions.reasoning: Ingen stærk ny katalysator i hverken retning. Streaming/parker-prisstigninger er en mindre margintailwind. Sidder tæt på både 50- og 200-dages SMA med neutral RSI 44 — holdes uændret for diversifikation.
bull: Sitting almost exactly on both the 50- and 200-day SMA with RSI at a neutral 44 — no technical damage, and the stock is bouncing today (+2.0%) as the broader market dips
Streaming and parks price increases (multiple tiers, Magic Kingdom ticket +$10) are direct margin/ARPU tailwinds if volumes hold
bear: No strong new catalyst either way — the neutral read reflects a genuinely balanced setup rather than a high-conviction case
Streaming competition and content-spend intensity remain structural headwinds regardless of near-term price increases

investment_plan.thesis: Neutral konglomerat-position — ingen stærk katalysator i hverken retning, holdes for diversifikation og stabil eksponering til streaming/parker.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $99,98. Sælg ved bekræftet nedgradering af tesen eller selskabsspecifik skuffelse.

decisions.name: Keysight Technologies
decisions.reasoning: AI-infrastruktur-tesen bekræftes af nyhedsflow om CSG-segmentets kobling til AI data-center-testbehov. Kun 1,25% fra price target ($360), og stoch 97,5/RSI 67,6 er maksimalt overkøbt kortsigtet — bedre købt på et dyk end jagtet her, men ingen selskabsspecifik skuffelse der udløser salg endnu. Holdes uændret, overvåges tæt for evt. gevinsthjemtagning nær target.
bull: Strong, broad-based uptrend — 9% above the 50-day SMA, 20% above the 200-day, +11% over both 5 and 20 days — with news flow tying its test-and-measurement (CSG) segment directly to AI infrastructure buildout demand
Only 4.7% off the 52-week high, confirming buyers are in control across multiple timeframes
bear: Stoch at 97.5 is maximally overbought short-term, and RSI 67.6 leaves limited room before the stock is technically extended too
AI-infrastructure capex narratives are already well discovered across the semiconductor test/equipment complex, raising the bar for further upside surprises

investment_plan.thesis: Neutral position — solid teknologieksponering uden stærk aktuel katalysator, holdes for stabil P&L og sektorspredning i Information Technology.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $289,67. Sælg ved bekræftet nedgradering af tesen eller selskabsspecifik skuffelse, eller ved gevinsthjemtagning nær/over price target.

decisions.name: Aflac
decisions.reasoning: Oversolgt kortsigtet (RSI 36, stoch 7) men holder fortsat 200-dages SMA. Dividendehævning efter 'mixed' earnings og positive sektor-read-throughs (Globe Life) understøtter fortsat indtjeningskraft. Stop ($111,84) er ikke i nærheden af udløst — holdes uændret.
bull: RSI 36 and stoch 7 are deeply oversold on the short-term swing, and price still sits fractionally above the 200-day SMA — this reads as a pullback inside a longer uptrend, not a trend break
Just raised its dividend after 'mixed' earnings, and peer read-throughs (Globe Life premium growth) suggest the group's earnings power is intact
bear: 5.0% below the 50-day SMA with 5d/20d momentum both negative — the stock is trending down into the oversold reading rather than bouncing from it
27% dividend increase followed by a stock decline suggests the market is discounting slower forward growth despite the payout signal

investment_plan.thesis: Neutral position i et defensivt forsikringsnavn — holdes for stabilitet og sektorspredning i Financials.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $111,84. Sælg ved bekræftet nedgradering af tesen eller selskabsspecifik skuffelse.

decisions.name: CrowdStrike
decisions.reasoning: Kursen ($259,67) har reelt ramt price target ($260) efter en 40% stigning over 20 dage. RSI 78,5/stoch 93 er ekstremt overkøbt, og momentum-divergensen (-32,5) viser markant afmatning efter det kraftige løb. Dagens verdict er nedgraderet til NEUTRAL. Snowflake-partnerskabet er et reelt nyt narrativ, men med tesen opfyldt og teknikken udstrakt er risk/reward ikke længere attraktiv herfra — tager gevinsten (+13,9%) frem for at jagte yderligere opside i en position der reelt har nået sit mål.
bull: Powerful trend — 40% over 20 days, 23% above the 50-day SMA and 74% above the 200-day SMA, with a potential new AI growth vector via the reported Snowflake partnership
Only 1.6% off the 52-week high; buyers have kept control of the stock through the run
bear: RSI 78.5 and stoch 93 are firmly overbought, and momentum divergence (-32.5) shows the pace of gains decelerating sharply from the 20-day surge
This much extension above both moving averages raises the odds of a sharp mean-reversion pullback on any negative catalyst

investment_plan.thesis: Position lukket: kursen har ramt price target ($260) efter en bekræftet beat-and-raise/AI-sikkerheds-tese, mens teknikken (RSI 78,5, stoch 93) er ekstremt udstrakt og verdict er nedgraderet til NEUTRAL. Gevinst tages fremfor at jagte yderligere opside.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Solgt i dag — price target nået samtidig med ekstremt overkøbte tekniske niveauer.

decisions.name: Nordson Corporation
decisions.reasoning: Fundamental tese intakt (rekord Q3, opjusteret guidance, 15% dividendehævning), men flere analytikerstemmer kalder aktien 'fuldt prissat' efter 52%-rallyet, og 20-dages momentum er negativt (-2,8%) på trods af 5-dages bounce. Hverken stop ($294,59) eller target ($345) er nået — holdes uændret, men som porteføljens største position (15,4% vægt) overvåges den nøje for tegn på at rallyet er udtømt.
bull: Comfortably above both SMAs (50-day +4.5%, 200-day +14.5%) after a record Q3 with raised guidance, and positioned for semiconductor-equipment growth
Only 4.4% below its 52-week high — the fundamental beat is being reflected in price
bear: Multiple analyst pieces are flagging it as 'fully valued' or 'fairly valued' after a 52% run, and stoch at 91 shows the stock is stretched short-term
20-day momentum is actually negative (-2.8%) despite the 5-day bounce, suggesting the rally is losing steam right at a valuation ceiling

investment_plan.thesis: Frisk fundamental katalysator (15% dividendehævning + beat-and-raise) gør Nordson til en attraktiv Industrials-eksponering efter MMM-salget.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $294,59. Sælg ved bekræftet nedgradering af tesen eller selskabsspecifik skuffelse, eller ved bekræftet brud under 50-dages SMA på stigende volumen.

decisions.name: Invitation Homes
decisions.reasoning: Mekanisk stop-loss udløst: kursen ($26,50) er under stoppet ($26,66), som allerede blev flaget som tæt på i går. Aktien er dybt oversolgt (RSI 9,4) og under både 50- og 200-dages SMA med negativ 20-dages momentum (-12,3%) — et genuint teknisk brud, ikke blot støj. Stoppet respekteres mekanisk uanset bounce-potentiale; realiseret tab ca. -3,85%.
bull: Extremely oversold — RSI 9.4, stoch 3.8 — after an 18% slide; several outlets are flagging it as reasonably valued or poised for a turnaround after the drop
Only 11.7% above its 52-week low, so most of the bad news around single-family-rental fundamentals looks priced in already
bear: Below both the 50-day (-9.4%) and 200-day (-3.7%) SMAs with 20-day momentum at -12.3% — this is a genuine downtrend, not just short-term noise
Persistently high mortgage rates keep pressuring the buy-vs-rent economics that underpin the SFR thesis

investment_plan.thesis: Position lukket: mekanisk stop-loss ($26,66) udløst. Turnaround-tesen er ikke nødvendigvis fejlet fundamentalt, men den tekniske trend (under 50- og 200-dages SMA, negativ momentum) bekræfter ikke at holde fast under stop.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Solgt i dag — mekanisk stop-loss udløst.
